scope: Authoritative unified 168-task x 5-HCL experiment; superseded historical cohorts remain archived

model_transport.credential_source: Existing user-scoped encrypted credential; never persist plaintext
model_transport.execution_environment: Authenticated native user environment for DPAPI, TLS and SSH

transport_recovery.request_payload: Immutable; preserve canonical SHA256 across retries
transport_recovery.rate_limit_policy: Bounded concurrency, paced starts, backoff with deferred worker release
transport_recovery.failure_scoring: Missing valid response is an unscored infrastructure blocker
transport_recovery.unknown_billing: Retain as unknown; never impute zero

evaluation_recovery.isolation: Per-candidate build directory; isolated serial retries after process abort or timeout
evaluation_recovery.unresolved_infrastructure: Blocks publication; never counted as a candidate failure
evaluation_recovery.candidate_nonconvergence: Requires saved candidate-only structural or dynamic evidence after isolated retries

model_output_failure.code_policy: Fixed output budget; syntax, truncation and ambiguous multiple source blocks remain scored failures
model_output_failure.contract_budget_exhausted: End only the affected repair branch; retain accepted predecessor; charge every support attempt
